mcat_description.short: A prefabricated warehouse is a factory-fabricated steel structure — typically a Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) — assembled on-site using bolted connections, sold as a complete turnkey project or supply-only structural kit for industrial storage and logistics use.
mcat_description.long: Prefabricated warehouses in India are predominantly Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) systems comprising factory-fabricated primary steel frames (tapered built-up sections), secondary members (purlins, girts, bracings), and colour-coated metal sheet or sandwich panel cladding, designed to IS 800, IS 875, and IS 1893 codes. The structures deliver large column-free clear spans — typically 18–36 metres for standard Indian industrial projects, extendable to 100+ metres — enabling high-density racking, forklift operation, and crane integration. A PUF-insulated sandwich panel variant serves cold storage, pharma, and food-grade warehousing requiring temperature control. Sellers offer supply-only kits (structure + cladding), design-supply-erect (DSE) turnkey contracts, or full civil+structural packages including foundation, flooring, and utilities.

market_context: In India, 'Prefabricated Warehouse' is commercially synonymous with Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) — a factory-fabricated steel portal frame system designed to IS 800 (structural steel), IS 875 (loads), and IS 1893 (seismic) codes, assembled on-site using bolted connections. PEB has displaced conventional RCC godown construction for single-storey industrial warehouses due to 40–60% faster construction timelines and 20–30% lower costs versus RCC. The dominant commercial form is a single-storey clear-span steel shed with Galvalume or colour-coated metal sheet roofing and wall cladding; PUF sandwich panel cladding (50–150mm) is specified for cold storage, pharma, and food-grade applications requiring temperature control. Buyers evaluate structures on clear span width, eave height, structural steel grade, cladding type, wind and seismic zone compliance, and whether the scope includes civil/foundation work. The market is served by pan-India PEB manufacturers (EPACK, BNAL, Alfa, Moonwalk, Pressmach, Kirby, Zamil) who offer supply-only kits or full turnkey DSE contracts. Key buyer segments include logistics/3PL operators, e-commerce distribution centres, FMCG manufacturers, agricultural commodity storage, and government/NABARD grain godowns. The term 'godown' is widely used interchangeably with 'warehouse' in Indian buyer vocabulary, particularly for smaller or agricultural storage structures.
